Claim: PM loop — `domain:spec` seat, `session_01MkQhmuuJAVDjmeWNixwDDH`, 2026-09-10T03:20Z. Dispatching one `os-dev` on branch `claude/issue-17063-retire-list-view-page-member`. Container & model: `mode:subagent`, `claude-opus-5`.

File surface (region level): `packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts` (the enum member, `pageName`, `checkListViewPageMount` and its three refusal messages at the three list-view doors), `packages/spec/src/stack.zod.ts` (`validateCrossReferences`' page-name branch), `packages/lint/src/validate-view-page-refs.ts`, `packages/spec/liveness/view.json`, plus whatever the retirement kit itself requires (tombstones, `RETIRED_*_BY_MAJOR` rows, an ADR-0087 disposition, regenerated artefacts) and the changeset.

```
Clause-②: no
```

Declared `no` on the direction, ⛔ not from the armchair: a retirement **narrows** the accept set — a member leaves an enum and an authorable key is removed. Nothing becomes newly acceptable and no new public capability appears.

⚠️ **But I expect this to be contested mechanically, and the dev is ordered to measure it rather than inherit my word.** `packages/spec/src/**` *is* a declared surface for `check-widening-tells`, and a retirement adds rows to `RETIRED_KEYS_BY_MAJOR` / `RETIRED_DEFS_BY_MAJOR` — **a new member of a closed set**, which is the T2 tell's own shape. So the mechanical reading may well come back adverse while the semantic direction stays `no`. The dev runs both probes (`--declaration no` and `--declaration yes`) plus `--pair`, reports all three, and ⛔ **stops rather than working around a disagreement** — the SEAT moves the declaration, ⛔ never the dev.

⭐ **This card gets an at-tier contract review either way, and that is a seat decision independent of the clause-② axis.** Tonight two PRs in this lane returned **REWORK** on exactly this class — a narrowing of *authorable, stored* metadata — and both times the defect was in the **stored-row consequence and the ADR-0087 disposition**, never in the code. ⛔ I am not declaring `yes` to buy a review; I am declaring what I measure and ordering the review on its own merits.

## Pre-dispatch checks, run rather than assumed

- **Action surface** — `git log origin/main` on all four paths: newest touching `view.zod.ts` is `7936b29ce` (#16697, exported object-level refinement checks), then `9c270bba0` (#16052), `b548e438d`, `f502898a4`. ⛔ None undoes this card's premise; the dev re-verifies the three measured line ranges on current `origin/main` before editing, because line numbers age (a sibling card's citations had drifted by up to 5,787 lines when re-measured tonight).
- **Card-reference surface, read live** — objectstack **#13216 closed completed** (the 2026-08-29 direction-1 ruling this reverses), **PR #13372 closed/merged** (the spec half that landed), and ⭐ **objectui#8429 is OPEN, `pm:blocked`, `domain:ui`** — the mount half that never landed and the reason this retirement exists. ⇒ **A cross-repo obligation falls due at ACCEPT**: once this lands, that card's premise is gone, and 规则 3 says the accepting seat files the follow-up in the consuming repo rather than leaving it to be noticed. ⛔ Not this round's edit; the seat's, at ACCEPT.
- **Same-file serialisation** — all four paths checked individually against every in-flight branch (`#17257`, `#17267`, `#17249`, `#17146`, `#17283`): **clear on all four**, no branch touches any of them.
- **Lock** — `lock is free`, `queue: empty` at 03:20Z ⇒ arrival depth **1**, below `LOCK_DEPTH_HOLD` (2). No wait owed.
- **Governed?** ⛔ No. `packages/spec/**` and `packages/lint/**` are on no row of `GOVERNED_SURFACES`; ordinary queue landing applies. The dev measures it on the final path list anyway and reports the exit code.

## The ruling is the spec, and the dev implements it, ⛔ does not relitigate it

Maintainer, 2026-09-09, decision batch #107 item 1, after two questions (what a `type: 'page'` list view is; when the requirement was decided and whether it is valuable). Options presented were **A** finish the objectui mount · **撤** retire under enforce-or-remove · **D** park with the current-state pin. Reply verbatim: **「撤」**.

⛔ Option A is not adopted, ⛔ option D is not adopted, and ⛔ the sunk cost of PR #13372 is not an argument — the governing four-axis principle is 「已发布零消费的能力不因沉没成本获得豁免」. ADR-0049 enforce-or-remove is the standing rule this executes.
